sources.citation: Peckham, Lloyd. 1991. Mairasi Phonology. Workpapers in Indonesian Languages and Cultures 10: 111-145. Jayapura: Cenderawasih University & SIL.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: For MAIRASI: 'Primary stress is on the penultimate syllable. Secondary stress on words longer than three syllables occurs on the first syllable' (p.112). For SEMIMI only note 2 (pp.141-142): five phonetic forms with stress marked, all penultimate: [kuku'idža] 'stick', ['kɛŋgɛ] 'dry', [ka'ɛřɛ] 'leaf', ['katu] 'seed', [kum'buřu] 'rotten'. No Semimi rule stated.
Wordlist forms only, no stress marks.
